Chewy yeasted pretzels dipped in a bicarb bath, scattered with rock salt and baked deep brown, with a hot honey and beer mustard for dunking. Mix 500g plain flour, 7g dried yeast, 1 tsp salt, 1 tbsp sugar and 320ml warm water, knead 8 minutes and rest 1 hour. Heat the oven to 220C. Roll into 8 long ropes and twist into knots. Simmer 2L water with 70g bicarb soda and dip each pretzel for 30 seconds. Place on lined trays, brush with egg, sprinkle rock salt and bake 12 to 14 minutes. Mix 80g wholegrain mustard, 2 tbsp honey and 2 tbsp lager for dipping.

Pork ribs, Italian sausages and meatballs browned and simmered for hours in a garlicky tomato sauce, tossed through rigatoni with parmesan and basil. Brown 600g pork ribs and 4 Italian sausages in olive oil in a large pot. Roll 400g beef mince with 1 egg, 40g breadcrumbs and 30g parmesan into 16 meatballs and brown. Remove all the meat. Fry 4 sliced garlic cloves for 1 minute, add 2 tbsp tomato paste, 1.4kg passata and 250ml water. Return the meat, cover partly and simmer gently for 2 to 3 hours, stirring often. Cook 500g rigatoni, toss with sauce and serve with the meat, basil and parmesan.

Cold lager topped with crisp green apple juice and a squeeze of lime, poured into frosty pint glasses with thin apple slices floating on top. Put 4 pint glasses in the freezer for 30 minutes. Juice 2 limes. Pour 200ml cold lager into each glass, then top with 150ml chilled cloudy green apple juice and a squeeze of lime. Slice 1 green apple very thin and float 2 slices in each glass. For non-drinkers, use ginger beer in place of the lager.

s.note: Pat Sr's crabby snacks for the Eagles game
s.how: Mix 250g crab meat with 125g cream cheese, a spoon of mayonnaise, lemon zest and sliced spring onion. Slice a baguette, spread the mix on each slice and grill until golden at the edges. Serve hot on game day.

s.note: the homemade snacks Pat Sr swears bring the Eagles luck
s.how: Mix 250g beef mince and 250g pork mince with grated parmesan, breadcrumbs and an egg. Roll into small balls and bake at 200C for 15 minutes. Warm tomato sauce with brown sugar until sticky and toss the meatballs through. Serve on toothpicks.

m.how: Freeze a 600g rib eye steak for 30 minutes and shave it thin. Fry sliced onion and green capsicum on a hot plate until soft, add the beef and sear fast. Lay provolone on top to melt and pile into long bread rolls. Go Birds.

w.note: Pat and Tiffany's awkward date at the diner
w.how: Soak 100g wheat bran in 300ml buttermilk for 10 minutes. Stir in 100g brown sugar, an egg, 60ml oil and 100g raisins, then fold in 200g self-raising flour. Bake in a muffin tin at 190C for 20 minutes. Serve warm with butter.
